_README: Regression suite for the 7:40 classifier. Every case here is a REAL
item that was reported as wrong, or a real item that must keep working.
expect = the section the item belongs in, or null to mean 'must be
dropped entirely'. 'why' records the incident so a future reader knows
what breaks if the case is deleted.
Add a case every time a miscategorisation is reported. Without this the
only feedback loop is someone spotting it in their inbox.
expect      = section from _classify() -- the FIVE-section taxonomy the 7:30 fallback report still uses.
expect_team = section from _classify_team() -- the THREE-section taxonomy the 7:40 mail uses (old S3 folds into S2; old S4+S5 become S3).
